en.title: Flight operations stopped at Cologne/Bonn after drone sighting on 27 November 2026
en.dek: All take-offs and landings were suspended for two and a half hours following a drone sighting at Cologne/Bonn airport.
facts: All starts and landings were suspended because of a drone sighting at Cologne/Bonn airport.
The disruption lasted two and a half hours, according to Tages-Anzeiger.
Air traffic control gave clearance to resume operations shortly after midnight, according to Tages-Anzeiger.
Die Zeit reported the flight operations stoppage on 27 November 2026.
body: Tages-Anzeiger reported that all starts and landings were suspended because of a drone sighting at Cologne/Bonn airport.
Die Zeit stated the flight operations in Cologne/Bonn were stopped following the drone sighting on 27 November 2026.
Air traffic control gave clearance to resume operations shortly after midnight, according to Tages-Anzeiger, which noted the interruption lasted two and a half hours.
en.context: No neutral background context is provided in the sources.

es.title: Las operaciones de vuelo se detuvieron en Colonia/Bonn tras la avistamiento de un dron el 27 de noviembre de 2026
es.dek: Todos los despegues y aterrizajes fueron suspendidos durante dos horas y media tras el avistamiento de un dron en el aeropuerto de Colonia/Bonn.
facts: Todos los despegues y aterrizajes fueron suspendidos por el avistamiento de un dron en el aeropuerto de Colonia/Bonn
La interrupción duró dos horas y media, según Tages-Anzeiger
El control de tráfico aéreo dio luz verde para reanudar las operaciones poco después de la medianoche, según Tages-Anzeiger
Die Zeit informó la suspensión de operaciones el 27 de noviembre de 2026
body: Tages-Anzeiger informó que todas las salidas y llegadas se suspendieron debido a la detección de un dron en el aeropuerto de Colonia/Bonn.
Die Zeit comunicó que las operaciones de vuelo en Colonia/Bonn se detuvieron tras el avistamiento del dron el 27 de noviembre de 2026.
Según Tages-Anzeiger, el control de tráfico aéreo dio luz verde para reanudar las operaciones poco después de la medianoche, señalando que la interrupción duró dos horas y media.

ko.title: 콜롬보/본 공항 드론 목격으로 항공기 운항 중단
ko.dek: 콜롬보/본 공항에서 드론 목격 소식에 따라 이륙·착륙이 2시간 30분간 중단됐다
facts: 콜롬보/본 공항에서 드론 목격으로 이륙·착륙이 2시간 30분간 중단됨
타게스-안차이거에 따르면 항공 교통 관제 당국이 자정 직후 운항 재개를 허가함
body: 콜롬보/본 공항 드론 목격으로 항공기 운항 중단
디 차이퉁은 2026년 11월 27일 콜롬보/본 공항 드론 목격 이후 항공기 운항이 중단됐다고 보도했다.
타게스-안자이거에 따르면 자정 직후 공중교통 관제당국이 운항 재개를 허가했으며, 중단 기간은 2시간 30분간 지속된 것으로 전해졌다.

problemsFixed: The headline is not a factual statement of what happened and is too conversational.
The dek is not a single sentence summary, max 30 words.
The facts list contains unsupported claims regarding the exact timing of resumption and duration without specific attribution.
The body contains loaded language ('reflects ongoing concerns'), speculation, and restatements.
The body paragraphs do not adhere to the required structure (opening with actor/number/date, varying sentence length, avoiding evaluative summaries).
The context section introduces speculation not supported by the sources.
The draft contains four short declarative sentences in a row in the facts list, violating rhythm rules.
The draft ends a paragraph with an evaluative summary in the body.
